title: Noa angle test on the five chosen faces
source_idea: consistency_rotation_test.md asks for a text prompt per angle, but text does not hold a face: the GPT and Grok profile pairs made from one prompt were measured as different people. This uses the video turnaround recipe that was admitted in 7 of 8 seeds yesterday - structured prompt, the chosen portrait plus its own face crop as two references, and the reference's own setting kept - so one face is carried continuously through the angles and the operator's profile rejection criteria can be judged on frames of the same person.
